verdict.rationale: ImageMagick is distributed as source on GitHub that developers can build and configure themselves (configure options, multi-OS support), and community users report running it freely in scripts and SaaS products. That implies a developer can run real conversions locally without any paywall, but the pack never explicitly states a free or open-source license or no-cost usage terms. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that ImageMagick is free/open-source (license terms), and documentation of a hosted sandbox or trial environment.
